text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Urgh... My arm's all stiff and<n>achy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Ya see, I was workin' on my<n>quick draw last
night.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I gave my model gun a good spin<n>'round my finger,
which really got my<n>blood pumpin'... and the rest is
history.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Hope I don't have to deal withit too long. Ow...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Taiki Shuttle isn't<n>feeling so great...
